gap: Does the unchanged curvature-regularized cold-start readout retain accuracy and speed over complete recordings, including the later configuration change?
initialization: Two fresh OnlineFit(prefix) constructions per case using original begin:first inclusive states and begin:first commands only; require exact parameter/normalizer equality. No saved model/session loads, offline training, fleet priors or reused learned state. Identical seed0 generic features, prefix-only two ridge solves. Record actual prefix bounds, sample counts, tape time of first prediction and synchronized construction/first-prediction/first-update latency. Prefix availability is not free: original quad begin50 first125 means scoring starts1.25s after release, using75 transitions from0.5s onward; fixedwing begin0 first15 means0.75s. Not an immediate throw-recovery trial.

arms.baseline: Unchanged public OnlineFit, one full-model 16-PCG update per observation.
arms.candidate: Unchanged CurvedReadout from be38729: same frozen features, measured midpoint targets, prefix ridge, role-balanced measured curvature domain and equilibrated shared Cholesky solve. No tuning, forgetting, backtracking or feature updates. Extend only the number of consecutive observations.
arms.frozen: Prediction-only copy of initial model as an unchanged-prefix diagnostic; no extra fitting.

measurement: After observing next state, reconstruct incoming filtered command/history/hidden state with existing _history on real context. Evaluate features at measured interval midpoint: average world velocities and body rates; Rmid=Rstart@exp(dt/4*(omega_start+omega_end)); filtered_mid=u+(incoming_filtered-u)*exp(-dt/(2*tau)); incoming lag history and hidden fixed across interval. Target=[Rmid.T@((v_next-v_start)/dt-gravity),(omega_next-omega_start)/dt]/output_scale. This is midpoint quadrature of measured increments; no measured accelerometer or simulator acceleration. The frozen feature loss is linear, while forecasts retain the unchanged nonlinear physical integrator. Noise/errors-in-variables and quadrature bias are unqualified.

evaluation.causality: Save each one-step prediction before revealing its next observation. Call observe exactly once per revealed transition. Only runner/scorer accesses the full sealed tape. Reset every case. Save initial/final parameters, all targets, predictions, times and work counts.
evaluation.conditional_forecasts: At every16th update offset, including0, save50ms/250ms conditional forecasts when full250ms truth is available. Actual future command tape is scoring-only. No controller or counterfactual truth claim.
evaluation.metrics: Same physical metrics and equal-case/equal-family geometric aggregation as short screen. Report first16,after16 and, where available,first100/after100 update errors. For quad-change report pre4s and post4s separately using source timestamps; this is descriptive, not a separate veto. Include the truncated quad-arm-135 tape without pretending it supplies a long-term result. No family dispatch in fitting.
evaluation.timing: Single CPU process, no concurrent heavy jobs. Alternate baseline/candidate update order each row, synchronize every arm; measure complete observe plus model snapshot. Record first-use compilation separately and all latencies; warmed median/p95 exclude first update only. Include all information-matrix/inverse setup in the relevant initialization. Record cumulative prediction+update+initialization compute curves and source-observation time separately; no live scheduler or hardware claim.
evaluation.stop: Finish bounded roster unless nonfinite model/forecast, exception, or600s wall budget; preserve partial results and stop the experiment on such failure. No broad offline fits, derivative campaign or simulator reruns for a clear loss.
evaluation.decision: Qualification evidence, not automatic promotion: equal-family median update ratio<=0.5, one-step primary<=1.15,250ms primary<=1.25, each-family primary<=1.5, all finite. Report late-stream and post-change losses even if aggregate improves. No retuning on the longer results. One candidate and one full-learner control, max3137updates each if tapes match prior inventory. Keep consumer/controller adoption separate.

verification: Freeze this extension before running. Use the unchanged scientific candidate from be38729. Authenticate tapes and sealed results; recompute scores. First64updates (62truncated) of both arms must reproduce the short-screen predictions, phi/target/penalty/mean exactly, also every overlapping conditional forecast and initialization. Verify each penalty against NumPy measured-cache reconstruction and each saved solve with both global and componentwise backward errors <=1e-10. Reconstruct G/Q and final model, verify frozen arrays and positive-definite final precision. No refitting. Report late-stream errors and all failures.

penalty.symbols: M is readout coefficients in the original normalized-output coordinates; M0 is the fresh prefix readout; lambda=0.01*initialized_transition_count as raw; n is the number of assimilated post-prefix transitions. beta_l=dt*output_scale_l/fixed_bootstrap_first_step_group_scale_l. Phi,Y are exactly the raw estimator's measured midpoint design and normalized acceleration targets.
penalty.objective: sum_l beta_l^2/(6*n) * (sum_i (phi_i@M_l-y_il)^2 + lambda*||M_l-M0_l||^2) + 0.5*sum_jl D_jl*M_quadratic_jl^2. D is the unchanged online._curvature_diagonal on the completed measured bootstrap/recent cache, current fixed normalizers and first-step loss scales. This is the existing 0.01/4 squared physical Hessian penalty; the data objective remains unrobust increment regression, not the production recursive Huber loss. Output-specific positive beta weights do not alter the unpenalized raw optimum.
penalty.solve: G=lambda*I+sum phi*phi^T; Q=lambda*M0+sum phi*y^T; M=solve(G+diag(d_n),Q). d_n is zero except quadratic rows, where d_n=3*n*D[:,0]/beta_0^2 =0.015*n*(factor/quadratic_scale)^2. D/beta^2 is identical across outputs. Data and prefix-ridge sufficient statistics are retained independently of the time-varying curvature penalty. Prefix M0 is not penalized or refit before first prediction.
penalty.domain: Reuse the current learner's 32 bootstrap/32 recent measured cache and role weights, reconstructed causally for each revealed observation. No simulator quantities. No future commands used to construct the penalty. Counts and measured-domain work are saved.
penalty.numerics: No precision inverse or numerical jitter. Equilibrate SPD system by sqrt(diagonal), Cholesky, triangular solves; nonfinite values fail the screen. Save each phi,target,penalty,solved M and final G,Q for stationarity checks without fitting.
